title: Meepleton
blurb: A pixel-art Joseon-era village that builds itself through the seasons, from thatched choga and tiled hanok to a magistrate hall under the cherry blossoms: meeples gather, haul and bridge the stream, then fly kites, make kimchi, wrestle at Dano, dance under the Chuseok moon, marry, raise families and grow old on the benches. Drag to explore, click anyone to follow them, press M for the map.
